ab.note: An Enlarged ν was probably intended to form νυν but was not written
An initial ε was likely intended to form επι and was not written
An enlarged initial ε was probably intended to form ειπεν but it was not written. Instead it is located three lines above where one would have expected the enlarged initial K to form και
The initial enlarged κ to form και was probably intended, but not written
